title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2608.24091v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal representations have been widely adopted in industrial e-commerce recommendation systems. Due to their strong semantic understanding and generalization capabilities, they enhance the performance of traditional sparse ID-based Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction models. Current multimodal application frameworks in the CTR prediction task typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first, pre-training a multimodal encoder on data from specific recommendation scenarios; second, extracting items' multimodal representations using this pre-trained multimodal encoder and integrating them into the CTR prediction model. However, the training objectives and data distribution of multimodal pre-training tasks often differ from those of the CTR prediction task, which limits the effectiveness of multimodal representation on downstream tasks. In this paper, we focus on how to learn Native Multimodal Representation for the CTR prediction task. One

translated_title: 电商场景下点击率预测的原生多模态表示学习
translated_abstract: 多模态表示已被广泛应用于工业电商推荐系统中。由于其强大的语义理解和泛化能力，它们提升了传统基于稀疏ID的点击率预测模型的性能。当前CTR预测任务中的多模态应用框架通常遵循两阶段范式：首先，在特定推荐场景的数据上预训练一个多模态编码器；其次，使用该预训练多模态编码器提取物品的多模态表示，并将其集成到CTR预测模型中。然而，多模态预训练任务的训练目标和数据分布往往与CTR预测任务不同，这限制了多模态表示在下游任务上的有效性。本文聚焦于如何为CTR预测任务学习原生多模态表示。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对CTR预测任务的原生多模态表示学习方法，旨在解决预训练任务与下游任务之间目标不匹配的问题，从而提升多模态表示在推荐系统中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a native multimodal representation learning method for CTR prediction, addressing the objective mismatch between pretraining and downstream tasks to enhance multimodal representation effectiveness in recommendation systems.
